title: The Muddled Umbrellas
story: Gus's left knee called for rain, and the knee was right: four people ducked into the Gull's Rest Inn for breakfast, and when the sun came out, all four left without their umbrellas. Priya Nair already keeps forty-one lost umbrellas, and she has no intention of making it forty-five. She means to return every one before the noon ferry. Whose umbrella is whose?
